# AI sprite sheet generator for games: GPT Image 2.6 to Phaser and Godot

**Turn a character still into a 16-frame run, walk, idle or attack cycle, sliced into a GIF, an atlas PNG and a JSON atlas for Phaser.**

**Typical cost** with `varg-character-design`: ~$0.06–0.24 per sheet, ~$0.83–2.03 per 5 s clip (tested). Models are billed at provider price, and the agent shows an estimate before you pay.

<p><a href="../../gpt-image-sprite-sheet/README.md"><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_1dadec5fbb07.webp" alt="A 4x4 sprite sheet of a cartoon knight sits on the left while the sliced frames play as a looping run cycle on the right." width="480"></a></p>

**Short answer:** start with [`gpt-image-sprite-sheet`](../../gpt-image-sprite-sheet/README.md): The strict 4×4 sheet prompt, then slice.sh cuts frames, keys the background, aligns the ground line and writes the GIF and atlases. The other 3 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-character-design --skill gpt-image-sprite-sheet --skill gpt-image-2-6 --skill gpt-image-gif
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Make a 16-frame run cycle sprite sheet of my knight from ./knight.png for Phaser."*

## What you need

- The generation steps call the [varg API](https://varg.ai) (Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more on one key). Sign in to the varg MCP with OAuth or set `VARG_API_KEY`. Models are billed at provider price, 1 credit = $0.01, and the agent shows an estimate before anything expensive.
- `varg-character-design`: ~$0.06–0.24 per sheet, ~$0.83–2.03 per 5 s clip (tested).
- `gpt-image-sprite-sheet`: ~$0.06 per 1024×1024 sheet (measured).
- `gpt-image-2-6`: ~$0.03–0.06 per image (measured).
- `gpt-image-gif`: ~$0.03–0.07 per GIF (measured).
- Any agent that reads Agent Skills: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and others ([install options](../../README.md#install)).

## FAQ

### Can GPT Image 2.6 make pixel-art sprites?

Not well: the model fails at pixel art, so use it for painted, cartoon or vector-style sprites.

### What frame size do I get?

The sheet divided by four: 256 px frames from a 1024×1024 sheet, 512 px from a 2048×2048 one.

### Does it work in Phaser and Godot?

slice.sh writes a TexturePacker JSON Hash atlas that Phaser loads directly, and the skill gives the Godot import steps.

### How much does a sprite sheet cost?

About $0.06 for a 1024×1024 sheet on GPT Image 2.6, measured on varg. Slicing and the atlas are free and local.
